degree.text: Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA) .

description.text: Note: The specialty is conducted in English with a prerequisite of a minimum number of 15 students . Before applying, pls contact SICAS for the latest information. Teaching Objectives To help student obtain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations. Main Courses Principles of Management,micro-economics,macro-economics,Management Information System,Statistics, Marketing,Economic Law, Human Resource Management,Enterprise Strategic Management, Finance Management Internship Human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise. Degree Awarded Bachelor Degree of Business Administration (BBA) . Future Career Graduates can engage in the field of human resources, planning, purchasing or sales management in the enterprise.

duration.text: The Business Administration at China University of Petroleum (Huadong) is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2083 USD/per year ￥ 15000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Academic transcript of high school 4. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above 3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
